# Third-party files in the "with DLLs" package

The package with DLLs contains two native libraries next to `Pathologic.exe`. They are **not** part of this mod,
are **not** covered by its MIT license and remain the property of their owners. They are included unmodified, only so
that the mod can use DLSS.

| File | Owner | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nvngx_dlss.dll` | NVIDIA Corporation | 310.9.1 | NVIDIA DLSS SDK, https://github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS |
| `NVUnityPlugin.dll` | Unity Technologies | build shipped with Unity 6000.2.6f2 (signed by Unity Technologies SF, SHA-256 `FB1C32303372259D143638D81513525EC0E19AF3659155BA9703329C15065813`) | Unity runtime, as shipped with Pathologic 3 |

`nvngx_dlss.dll` is distributed under the NVIDIA RTX SDKs License, see `NVIDIA-RTX-SDKs-LICENSE.txt`.
This mod is not sponsored or endorsed by NVIDIA, Unity Technologies or Ice-Pick Lodge.

If you prefer not to use these copies, take the mod-only package and get the files yourself as described in README.md.
